messages:
alicia: noticing apiserver 5xx spike in eu2 around 08:11UTC; controller-manager losing leader lease repeatedly.
ben: etcd leader flipped a few times, some followers showing high RTTs (~250ms). GPU onboarding jobs failing on attach.
sre-oncall: getting dial timeouts to etcd from apiserver - suspecting recent natgw change. can netops confirm?
netops: we scaled up natgw at 08:09 and enabled ephemeral SNAT expansion to handle image-pull surge. changeID=nw-889.
ops-eric: that matches the timing. apiserver logs show connect timeouts immediately after.
ben: apiserver log snippet:

``
E0402 08:11:14.789 proxy.go:45] proxy error: dial tcp 10.3.14.22:2379: i/o timeout
I0402 08:11:32.010 leaderelection.go:77] failed to acquire lease: context deadline exceeded
``

sre-oncall: quick mitigation - enabling sticky SNAT on natgw and disabling ephemeral expansion. applying now.
netops: sticky SNAT toggled by @sre-oncall at 08:17UTC. rolling rollback of nw-889 queued.
alicia: after sticky SNAT, etcd RTTs dropped to ~20-30ms and leader stabilized. controller-manager reacquired lease.
ops-eric: pausing eu2 GPU onboarding and routing new onboarding tasks to eu1 for 30m to avoid thundering attach.
infra-bot: provisioner: policy update by @ops-eric at 08:19UTC - route onboarding eu2 -> eu1 (onboarding=true) :white_check_mark:.
ben: bumped controller-manager leader election retry to 20s while we validate network fixes. will revert later.
sre-oncall: created INC-4012 and assigned eng-sre + netops. please attach apiserver latency, etcd leader changes, natgw metrics. monitoring window 60m.
alicia: note added: expected short cost bump due to cross-region work (~+15% for the hour). will track billing.
sre-oncall: if stable for 30m we’ll re-enable onboarding gradually with attach-backoff in scheduler. thanks everyone.
